scripts.lint:ui: echo "packages/ui has no lint config; covered by typecheck:ui"
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:admin && npm run lint:web
scripts.test:db: node scripts/test-preflight.mjs && DATABASE_ADMIN_URL="${DATABASE_ADMIN_URL:-postgres://resort:resort@localhost:5433/postgres}" npm run test -w @resort-booking/api -- integration
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @resort-booking/api && npm run typecheck -w @resort-booking/admin && npm run typecheck -w @resort-booking/web && npm run typecheck -w @resort-booking/ui && npm run typecheck -w @resort-booking/shared-types
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:all && npm run test:full && npm run security:check
scripts.db:migrate:orb: npm run db:up:orb && npm run migrate -w @resort-booking/api
